name: Underswap: Nuts in Bolts (Don't Actually)
source:
Nuts in Bolts (Don't Actually) is visual novel centered around the player romancing DJ Blook/Napstaton and Metta/Hapstabot from the Undertale AU: Underswap. 

[from [url=https://lovely-knives.itch.io/nuts-in-bolts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Nuts in Bolts》（实际上并非如此）是一款视觉小说，以《Undertale AU: Underswap》中的DJ Blook/Napstaton和Metta/Hapstabot的玩家爱情故事为中心。

[来自[url=https://lovely-knives.itch.io/nuts-in-bolts]itch.io[/url]]
